title: About Rooted Data
text:
Rooted Data was founded on a simple principle: data analysis is most powerful when it is deeply connected to place and community.
Operating as an independent, single-founder practice, Rooted Data provides direct, end-to-end expertise—from technical architecture and spatial data modeling to stakeholder facilitation and web tool development.



Andrea Tentner, PhD
Principal & Founder, Rooted Data
I am an urban analyst, data engineer, and practitioner with a background spanning GIS, data science, data ethics, and community engagement. I work closely with local governments, non-profits, research institutions, and community organizations to build data infrastructure that lasts.



Languages & Tools: R, Python, SQL, Git, Quarto, PostGIS
Web & Mapping: Mapbox, Leaflet, Shiny, Streamlit
Domain Expertise: Urban informatics, ethical data governance, spatial equity

title: Rooted Data
text:
Data solutions rooted in community and place.


Rooted Data is an independent data consultancy specializing in urban analytics, spatial science, ethical data governance, and custom web tools for public, civic, and community impact.

Explore Our Services Get in Touch

title: Rooted Data
text:
Core Capabilities


🗺️ Mapping & Urban Analytics
Advanced spatial modeling, GIS analysis, and urban informatics to uncover geographic patterns and inform equitable planning decisions.


🔒 Data Governance & Sharing
Building ethical data governance frameworks, data-sharing protocols, and privacy-preserving pipelines for inter-agency collaboration.


🛠️ Software & Web App Tools
Custom open-source tools, interactive dashboards, and web applications built to make complex data accessible and actionable.


🤝 Community Engagement
Designing participatory data workflows, community-led data collection, and inclusive reporting that center local voices.

title: Services & Expertise
text: At Rooted Data, technical analytical rigor meets deep context awareness. Every project is tailored to ensure data serves both organizational goals and the broader public good.

title: Services & Expertise
text:
What We Do

1. Urban Analytics & Spatial Science
We combine geospatial analysis with data science to model urban systems, environmental patterns, and demographic shifts. * Custom GIS workflows & spatial data pipelines * Spatial statistics & predictive land-use modeling * Interactive web maps and spatial dashboards


2. Data Governance & Responsible Sharing
Data is most valuable when shared safely and ethically. We help organizations build trust and infrastructure around sensitive datasets. * Data governance framework development * Secure inter-organizational data sharing agreements * Ethical data risk assessments and privacy protection


3. Custom Software & Interactive Tools
When off-the-shelf software falls short, we design custom analytical tools and web interfaces tailored to your team’s workflow. * Web applications (R Shiny, Python Streamlit, React/Mapbox) * Open-source data pipelines and R/Python packages * Automated reporting systems


4. Community-Centered Engagement
Data should empower communities, not alienate them. We facilitate collaborative research and participatory data design. * Participatory mapping & community co-design workshops * Accessible data storytelling and public report design * Community data literacy training
